<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_SalesOrder" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/sales-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_QuoteApproval" name="Quote approval"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Sales">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Sales and Customer Support" processRef="Process_Sales"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Inquiry" name="Inquiry" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_QuoteApproval" name="Quote approval" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_QuoteApproved" messageRef="Message_QuoteApproval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="SendTask_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Sales" name="Sales Order Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddressConcerns" name="Address concerns and questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerInterested" name="Customer interested?" default="Flow_NotInterested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Interested</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotInterested</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuideSelection" name="Guide customer through product or service selection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Interested</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareQuote" name="Provide quote">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_QuoteApproved" name="Customer approves quote">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_QuoteApproval" messageRef="Message_QuoteApproval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Record order in system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed" name="Order placed and confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotInterested" name="Inquiry closed without order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotInterested</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Task_AddressConcerns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_AddressConcerns" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerInterested" targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${customerInterested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerInterested" targetRef="EndEvent_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Task_PrepareQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_PrepareQuote" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_QuoteApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_QuoteApproved" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="SendTask_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="SendTask_SendConfirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
